senses.gloss: m. (נתר, Hif. הִתִּיר) release, legal permission, permitted object, legitimate action, opp. אִיסּוּר.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 86b:1">Yoma 86ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>נעשית לו כה׳</he> it appears to him like a legitimate act.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:14">Y. Sabb. VII, 9ᵈ</cite> top <he>יש לה ה׳ וכ׳</he> there is a time when the legal restriction concerning her is removed.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 76:9">Gen. R. s. 76</cite>, end; s. 80 beg. <he>להשיאה דרך ה׳</he> to give her in marriage in a legitimate way.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:11">Num. R. s. 10</cite>, beg. <he>אלו שהיו נוהגין ה׳ וכ׳</he> those who consider the connection with hand-maids permitted.

Y. Yeb. I, beg. 2ᵃ להֶיתֵּירָהּ הראשון to the original status of free choice; a. fr.—Esp. ה׳ (נדרים) the release from a vow by the declaration of a scholar after finding due reasons for its annulment, v. פֶּתַח.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chagigah 1:8">Ḥag. I, 8</cite> <he>ה׳ נ׳ פורחין באויר</he> the rules concerning the release from vows hang in the air (have no biblical foundation).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 9:1:3">Y. Naz. IX, beg. 57ᶜ</cite> <he>ה׳ חכם</he> dispensation by a scholar’s decision; a. fr.
